title: Threshold audit population protocol
purpose: Parameterized protocol for building a large-compute audit population above threshold T without hard-coding a political or treaty threshold.

threshold_T.unit: MW IT-equivalent or other formally defined metric
threshold_T.unit_note: Express T in H100-equivalents (H100e) with a recorded conversion from MW, so the threshold matches how the AI 2040 supplement counts compute. track3_units.py implements that conversion; data/track3/h100e_conversion.json holds its assumptions and the supplement's example of about 30,000 H100e.

rules: Never substitute queue MW for IT MW without an explicit conversion record.
Resolve parent/subsidiary names through the entity graph before counting.
Store excluded/unknown cases separately rather than silently dropping them.
